geometry_edits.rationale: Keep the lifted mass aligned to the verified access side so the public threshold remains access-responsive.
Slightly strengthen the lift to create a clearer ground void and upper hierarchy.
Preserve a clean anchor so the lifted body still reads as one stable mass.
Reduce vertical bulk slightly to keep the silhouette calm after the lift.

rationale: The candidate reads as one coherent neighborhood building mass across the four views, with a stable courtyard/void gesture and a legible dominant enclosure. The parcel response is broadly coherent: the mass sits within the boundary and leaves a meaningful internal open figure rather than merely filling the box. The blue access edge is acknowledged by a ground-level opening/undercut on the frontage side, so the street condition is not sealed. That said, the form still feels somewhat box-led and the section is only moderately articulated; the stepped/void logic is present but not strongly profiled enough to become the sole organizing idea. Overall it is program-fit for neighborhood living because it can plausibly support active ground, public threshold, and upper mass hierarchy without reading as a different typology.

reference_assessments.transferable_principle: Courtyard-centered low-rise massing with a clear bridge/void relationship and restrained upper articulation.
Terraced campus-like composition around a central public open space; useful for hierarchy and ground court logic.
Elongated mass with central void and a legible roof datum; transferable as a calm horizontal public building language.
Split, connected low-rise masses with terrace/bridge circulation and a public open core; strong match to the current language.
Interlocking volumes framing a courtyard and layered upper masses; supports active ground and hierarchy.

warnings: The silhouette is coherent but still somewhat generic in section; more deliberate profile or a cleaner anchor could strengthen the massing.
The open space is legible, but the public threshold could be made more emphatic if further iteration is desired.
